```{python}
import json
from pathlib import Path

import plotly.graph_objects as go
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown

DATA = json.loads((Path.cwd() / "data" / "dashboard.json").read_text())

LEAD = "#1f6feb"
REST = "#a9c9f5"
TEXT = "#30363d"
FONT = "Source Sans Pro, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif"

COLUMNS = ["#", "", "Club", "P", "W", "D", "L", "GF", "GA", "GD", "Pts"]


def bar(labels, values, unit):

    """
    Horizontal bar, highest at the top. Plotly draws category axes bottom-up, so
    the lists are reversed to put the leader where a reader looks first.

    No title and no x axis: the heading names the chart and the value sits on the
    bar. The leader takes the accent colour, the rest a tint of it.
    """

    colours = [LEAD] + [REST] * (len(values) - 1)
    ceiling = max(values) * 1.18 if values else 1

    figure = go.Figure(
        go.Bar(
            x=values[::-1],
            y=labels[::-1],
            orientation="h",
            marker=dict(color=colours[::-1], cornerradius=4),
            text=[f"{value:,}" for value in values[::-1]],
            textposition="outside",
            textfont=dict(color=TEXT, size=13),
            hovertemplate=f"%{{y}}<br>%{{x:,}} {unit}<extra></extra>",
        )
    )
    figure.update_layout(
        height=max(240, 52 * len(labels)),
        bargap=0.45,
        margin=dict(l=0, r=70, t=10, b=10),
        font=dict(family=FONT, size=13, color=TEXT),
        xaxis=dict(visible=False, range=[0, ceiling]),
        yaxis=dict(showgrid=False, ticksuffix="  "),
        showlegend=False,
        plot_bgcolor="white",
        paper_bgcolor="white",
    )
    return figure


def table(rows):

    """
    Plain HTML rather than go.Table, which cannot put an image in a cell. The
    classes come from the cosmo theme, so the table needs no CSS of its own.
    """

    head = "".join(f"<th>{column}</th>" for column in COLUMNS)

    body = []
    for position, row in enumerate(rows, 1):
        icon = row["team_icon_url"]
        body.append(
            "<tr>"
            f"<td>{position}</td>"
            f'<td>{f"""<img src="{icon}" alt="" style="height:22px">""" if icon else ""}</td>'
            f'<td>{row["team_name"]}</td>'
            f'<td>{row["played"]}</td>'
            f'<td>{row["won"]}</td>'
            f'<td>{row["drawn"]}</td>'
            f'<td>{row["lost"]}</td>'
            f'<td>{row["goals_for"]}</td>'
            f'<td>{row["goals_against"]}</td>'
            f'<td>{row["goal_difference"]:+d}</td>'
            f'<td><strong>{row["points"]}</strong></td>'
            "</tr>"
        )

    return HTML(
        '<table class="table table-sm align-middle">'
        f"<thead><tr>{head}</tr></thead>"
        f"<tbody>{''.join(body)}</tbody>"
        "</table>"
    )
```

```{python}
Markdown(f"""
::: {{.lead}}
Rebuilt every Monday evening, without anyone touching it: the warehouse reloads from
the OpenLigaDB feed, this page re-renders and publishes itself. Last run {DATA['generated_at']}.
:::
""")
```

## Current season

### Standings

A win is worth three points, a draw one point for each club and a defeat none.
Clubs level on points are separated by goal difference, then by goals scored.

```{python}
table(DATA["standings"])
```

### Top scorers (this season)

```{python}
rows = DATA["top_scorers_season"]
bar([r["player_name"] for r in rows], [r["goals"] for r in rows], "goals")
```

## History

### Top scorers (past ten years)

```{python}
rows = DATA["top_scorers_last_10"]
bar([r["player_name"] for r in rows], [r["goals"] for r in rows], "goals")
```

### Venues by matches hosted (since 2010)

```{python}
rows = DATA["matches_by_venue"]
bar(
    [f"{r['location_stadium']} ({r['location_city']})" for r in rows],
    [r["matches"] for r in rows],
    "matches",
)
```

### Teams with most wins (since 2006)

```{python}
rows = DATA["most_wins_all_time"]
bar([r["team_name"] for r in rows], [r["wins"] for r in rows], "wins")
```
